name: u1-klipper-tmc-autotune
title: TMC Autotune for Snapmaker U1
author: Andrew McGregor and contributors; Snapmaker U1 adaptation contributors
description: Packages Klipper TMC Autotune for the Snapmaker U1 vendor Klipper layout, targeting BJ42D29-100V78 motors on the TMC2240 X/Y axes and a BJ42D22-130 motor on the TMC2209 Z axis. Bespok3d collects the unpublished winding constants, renders a printer-specific configuration, preserves the stock sensorless-homing thresholds, and handles placement, restart, rollback, reconfiguration, and removal.
tagline: Motor-aware TMC tuning with U1-safe configuration.

variables.name: U1_XY_RESISTANCE
variables.description: BJ42D29-100V78 phase resistance in ohms from its exact datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_XY_INDUCTANCE
variables.description: BJ42D29-100V78 phase inductance in henries from its exact datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_XY_MAX_CURRENT
variables.description: BJ42D29-100V78 rated phase current in amperes.

variables.name: U1_Z_RESISTANCE
variables.description: BJ42D22-130 phase resistance in ohms from its exact datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_Z_INDUCTANCE
variables.description: BJ42D22-130 phase inductance in henries from its exact datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_Z_MAX_CURRENT
variables.description: BJ42D22-130 rated phase current in amperes.

config.label: BJ42D29-100V78 resistance (ohms)
config.hint: Enter the exact per-phase resistance; generic BJ42D29 values are not interchangeable.

config.label: BJ42D29-100V78 inductance (henries)
config.hint: Enter henries, not millihenries: divide the exact per-phase mH value by 1000.

config.label: BJ42D29-100V78 holding torque (Nm)
config.hint: Enter newton-metres, not Ncm or mNm.

config.label: BJ42D29-100V78 rated current (A)
config.hint: Use the motor's rated phase current, not Klipper's 1.2 A run_current.

config.label: BJ42D22-130 resistance (ohms)
config.hint: Enter the exact per-phase resistance; generic BJ42D22 values are not interchangeable.

config.label: BJ42D22-130 inductance (henries)
config.hint: Enter henries, not millihenries: divide the exact per-phase mH value by 1000.

config.label: BJ42D22-130 holding torque (Nm)
config.hint: Enter newton-metres, not Ncm or mNm.

config.label: BJ42D22-130 rated current (A)
config.hint: Use the motor's rated phase current, not Klipper's 0.85 A run_current.
